_comment: Single source of truth for every MC-version-sensitive fact. Nothing here may be hardcoded in codegen -- generators read profiles from this file keyed by the pinned game version.

fabric.mappings_note: 26.x is post-obfuscation: Mojang ships a NAMED (de-obfuscated) client jar. No yarn / mojang mapping files exist for 26.2. Fabric's intermediary-26.2.jar is an empty identity map (v1 official intermediary). Loom gets a generated 3-column identity tiny (official->intermediary->named) and remapSourcesJar is disabled. VERIFIED 2026-08-08: generated project compiles with gradle build on real 26.2 deps.
fabric.loom_note: loom 1.17.19 = latest stable on maven.fabricmc.net (verified 2026-08-06; 1.18.0 is alpha)
fabric.gradle_note: gradle 9.x required to run on JDK 26 (8.14's embedded kotlin fails parsing the 26.0.1 java version)

pack.provenance: Read from Mojang's shipped 26.2 client jar: version.json pack_version = {data_major:107, data_minor:1, resource_major:88}, cross-checked against built-in experimental datapacks (minecart_improvements / redstone_experiments / trade_rebalance) whose pack.mcmeta declares max_format 107 / min_format [107,1]. Verified 2026-08-06.
